comment: The starter questline on Emberholm, and its milestones. Read by src/content/quests.ts and server/src/life. Each quest is offered by `giver` once everything in `after` is done, has steps of objectives counted from events the life systems raise, and is handed in to `turnIn` (the giver unless named). A milestone starts by itself and is done the moment its steps are. Objective types: talk, reach, plant, harvest, gather (kind: timber, stone, ore, herbs; n counts what you get, a node's or a felled tree's yield), craftPack, deliver, glide, summon, ride, load, placeScarecrow, placeHouse, buildStage, sell, buy, defeat (kind), skillLevel. rewards.skillPoints are points for the skill tree: you have skills.startPoints (tuning.json) plus those of everything you have finished.

quests.name: Landfall
quests.intro: Welcome to Emberholm, traveller. You came on the morning boat with nothing but your boots, I see. Lanternwick looks after its own - come and speak with me by the well.

steps.text: Speak with Reeve Hollis by the well in Lanternwick

quests.outro: Good. Every Emberholmer starts with a patch of earth. Here's a scarecrow to mark yours, and seeds to put in it.

quests.name: A Patch of Earth
quests.intro: Out east past the stables are Barleybrook Fields - open, level ground. Set your scarecrow anywhere the soil is flat and free, and get those seeds in the ground. They'll grow whether you watch them or not.

steps.text: Place your scarecrow on open, level ground (Barleybrook Fields is ideal)
Plant seeds in your plot

quests.outro: Now they grow. Sunroot's quick; barley takes its time. Water them if you like - it hurries them along - and pray for rain.

quests.name: Wings over the Windspire
quests.intro: While your crops grow: see that crag to the north? The Windspire. A path climbs its face to the top, where Ysolde Windward makes wings. Tell her Hollis sent you.

steps.text: Climb the ledge path to the top of the Windspire
Speak with Ysolde Windward at the glider launch

quests.outro: Hollis sent you? Then take this - a Wayfarer, my own make. Run off the deck, jump, jump again in the air, then once more to open it. Sprint to dive, crouch to flare. Ride the warm air at the cliff's foot to climb.

quests.name: First Flight
quests.intro: Off you go. Glide all the way down to Lanternwick - stay up as long as you can.

steps.text: Glide for 20 seconds
Land in Lanternwick and report to Reeve Hollis

quests.outro: Ha! I saw you come over the rooftops. Ysolde will be insufferable. Here - a Charter Seal for your trouble. Seals are what the Registry trades land for.

quests.name: First Harvest
quests.intro: When your crops are ripe, bring them in. Harvesting takes labor - your stamina for honest work - which comes back with time and rest.

steps.text: Harvest ripe crops from your plot

quests.outro: A fine first harvest. Now, produce alone sells for pennies. Tamsin at the workbench can show you how to turn it into real coin.

quests.name: The Packwright's Trade
quests.intro: Produce is worth a few coppers here and a great deal somewhere it doesn't grow. Bring six sunroot and four barley to my bench and I'll show you how to pack a Harvest Crate. Mind - you'll carry it on your back, and it's heavy.

steps.text: Craft a Lanternwick Harvest Crate at the Specialty Workbench

quests.outro: There. Feel that weight? No sprinting, no second jump, no gliding with it. Now take it somewhere that wants it.

quests.name: Westward Bound
quests.intro: Westwatch Trading Post sits on the western headland - follow the west road past Hearthside Rise and up the cliffs. Dunmore pays well for Lanternwick goods. Every crate you sell there drops his price a little, so watch the demand.

steps.text: Deliver a trade pack to Dunmore Vell at Westwatch

quests.outro: Lanternwick sunroot! The cooks will weep. If you mean to make a habit of this, old Bertram in the village builds carts - four crates at a time beats one on your back.

quests.name: Wheels of Commerce
quests.intro: Dunmore sent word you'd be by - and paid for the cart up front, the old softie. Open your bag (I) and summon it, or press V. Carry packs to the bed to load them, and unload at the other end. Two crates to Westwatch, if you please.

steps.text: Summon your farm cart
Load trade packs into the cart
Deliver two trade packs to Westwatch

quests.outro: Now you're a trader. Sela at the stables can sell you a donkey for the hills, and Captain Ilsa down at the docks has something for the sea.

quests.name: Salt and Sail
quests.intro: Gullrock's an islet off the south-east coast - Factor Pell there pays half again what Westwatch does, and in Charter Seals besides. No road goes there. Take this rowboat deed; summon it at the water's edge. Two packs fit in her stern.

steps.text: Summon your rowboat at the shore
Deliver a trade pack to Factor Pell on Gullrock

quests.outro: Rowed it yourself? Respect. Come back with a proper sloop and the sea will make you rich.

quests.name: Stone from Stonebreak
quests.intro: Land is granted by blueprint, but a blueprint is only paper. A cottage stands on stone and timber, and nobody hands you either ready-cut: you quarry the stone and cut the blocks yourself. Brenna Stoneheart keeps Stonebreak Quarry, up the north road and west along the quarry fork. Go and learn the trade from her.

steps.text: Go to Stonebreak Quarry and speak with Brenna Stoneheart
Quarry 10 stone from the pale rock outcrops (F)
Cut a Stone Block at the Stonecutter's Table

quests.outro: A good square block, and it's yours. A cottage takes three of them, and an Iron Fittings Crate for the roof: six ore from the rust-streaked rocks, packed at this same table. Set the block down (X) or load it on your cart - nobody ties timber with stone on their back. And if your arms give out, my stores sell stone and ore by the piece.

quests.name: Timber from Thornwood
quests.intro: Stone's half a house. The other half is timber, and Hob Ashgrove cuts it at his camp on the edge of Thornwood, where the east road ends. He'll show you how to chop the deadfall and bundle it, and his woodpile sells lumber if you'd rather pay than chop. Once you've a bundle tied, tell Registrar Quill you're ready to build.

steps.text: Speak with Hob Ashgrove at his camp in Thornwood, where the east road ends
Chop 10 lumber from the deadfall timber around his camp (F)
Tie a Lumber Bundle at Hob's Sawhorse

quests.outro: Stone from Stonebreak, timber from Thornwood: now you know what a house is made of. A cottage takes three Stone Blocks, five Lumber Bundles and an Iron Fittings Crate - more hauling than you'd think, so take your cart. Here's a Charter Seal toward your blueprint.

quests.name: A Place to Call Home
quests.intro: Land on Emberholm is granted by blueprint. A Cottage Blueprint costs three silver and three Charter Seals; place it on any empty plot at Hearthside Rise. Then build it in four stages: three Stone Blocks and an Iron Fittings Crate from the Stonecutter's Table at Stonebreak Quarry, and five Lumber Bundles from Hob's Sawhorse in Thornwood. Haul them to the site on your back or by cart.

steps.text: Place a Cottage Blueprint on a plot at Hearthside Rise
Build all four stages with packs from Stonebreak Quarry and Thornwood

quests.outro: Signed, sealed, and yours - so long as the taxes are paid. Welcome home, neighbour.

quests.name: A Ship of Your Own
quests.intro: A rowboat's a fine thing for a bay. For the open sea you want a cog: sixteen packs in her hold and a square sail. I'll sell you the design - ten silver and six Charter Seals - and you build her on the slipway beside my shed. Lumber bundles from Hob, iron crates from Brenna, sailcloth from flax at the Lanternwick bench.

steps.text: Lay a Merchant Cog Design on the Lanternwick slipway
Build all four stages of the cog
Launch her

quests.outro: Look at her sit in the water! Fill that hold, mind the wind, and Gullrock will make you rich.

quests.name: Feathers and Fleece
quests.intro: Crops are all very well, but a farm wants animals. Here's a chick - raise her in a cell of your plot, keep her fed on barley, and she'll lay for you. Bring in her first eggs and I'll find you a lamb.

steps.text: Raise the chick in your plot (Z picks what F plants)
Keep her fed with barley and collect her eggs

quests.outro: Fresh eggs! Mara will buy them, or pack them in a Farmhouse Hamper and they'll fetch far more abroad. Take this lamb - the same rules apply.

quests.name: Under Contract
quests.intro: Selling whatever you happen to carry is fine. Selling what I need is better. I post contracts on my board - so many packs of a kind, by a deadline, with a bonus in seals. Take one and fill it.

steps.text: Take a trade contract at a trading post and fill it

quests.outro: That's how the big traders do it: they know what's wanted before they pack it. Check the boards here and at Gullrock.

quests.name: Green Thumb
quests.intro: Anyone can bring in one harvest. Keep at it.

steps.text: Harvest 30 crops

quests.outro: The fields know your hands now.

quests.name: Sky Legs
quests.intro: Ysolde says the wind only trusts you once you have given it some time.

steps.text: Glide for two minutes in all

quests.outro: You read the air like a gull.

quests.name: Pack Mule
quests.intro: One delivery is luck. Five is a trade.

steps.text: Deliver 5 trade packs

quests.outro: The posts know your face.

quests.name: Rancher
quests.intro: A lamb is a start. A flock is a farm.

steps.text: Raise 3 animals

quests.outro: Your pens are never quiet now.

quests.name: Contract Hand
quests.intro: Dunmore keeps a ledger of who delivers what they promise.

steps.text: Complete 5 trade contracts

quests.outro: Your name is good on any ledger.

quests.name: Wayfarer
quests.intro: Fields, rise, spire, forest, quarry, strand and the far post: see them all.

steps.text: Set foot in every corner of Emberholm

quests.outro: There is no corner of the island you have not walked.

quests.name: Slime Hunter
quests.intro: The meadow slimes leave you be until you start something. Start something.

steps.text: Defeat 15 slimes

quests.outro: The meadow is a little quieter.

quests.name: Practised Hand
quests.intro: Every skill you use gets better with use. Use them.

steps.text: Gain 5 skill levels

quests.outro: Practice made you better.
